layer_notes.condition_required_cut: Empty in G1 on purpose. This line is shadow-only and emits no learned cut to any master. open_obligations.statement: Capability is computed per body. Nothing in the evaluator, the master, the expansion or the audit requires that all bodies of one pattern can take pairwise distinct active front cells at the same time, and 207 of the 258 CLEAN patterns in L0 union L1-dense have at least one free front cell shared by two or three bodies. The repository probably allows exactly this sharing -- src/models/routing_subproblem._duplicate_terminal_front_keys only blocks a repeated (front cell, terminal_dir, commodity, port_type) quadruple, and two bodies adjacent to one cell necessarily face it from opposite directions -- but that argument is not a proof. Since 2026-08-04 the G1 gate carries a per-run discharge check (run_g1.check_front_simultaneity) and clause six makes PASS unreachable while this obligation is open; the obligation stays registered because the check discharges one geometry at a time, which is not the same as proving the assumption away.
open_obligations.effect_on_this_batch: none: the model is more permissive than the real rule, so an INFEASIBLE under it is the stronger statement
closure_options: per run: exhibit a system of distinct representatives over the run's own geometry -- implemented as run_g1.check_front_simultaneity, wired into gate clause six (open_obligations_discharged), fail-closed
once and for all: prove the sharing-is-legal argument against the repository and register it as a theorem here
or make it structural: add a distinct-representatives check to g1_pattern_evaluator.evaluate_pattern so no pattern without a witness can enter a catalog

theorems.statement: A body's servable class set is determined by cap = max over side pairs with both sides non-empty of max(n_X, n_Y). Bucketing is lossless with respect to that per-body quantity, so assigning classes to buckets is equivalent to assigning them to bodies -- but the quantity itself is computed per body with no cross-body simultaneity check, which makes the abstraction a relaxation of the real rule rather than an equivalence (open obligation O-FRONT-SIMULTANEITY). Eight buckets are reachable, not eleven, because a square's mode set is closed under swapping a pair's two sides.

Without it the CORE region -- which provably holds no manufacturing body -- would have nothing to take and the master would report INFEASIBLE for a bookkeeping reason.

theorems.statement: Every region takes exactly one pattern, so for any bucket the board can hold at most the sum over region classes of (that class's richest pattern in that bucket) times its multiplicity. The same argument bounds the total body count and each template family. Each ceiling over-counts, because it picks every region class's best pattern independently; a ceiling below the census therefore proves the catalog cannot cover it, while a ceiling above the census excludes nothing.

theorems.statement: At most three power poles per 14x14 region. Registered 2026-08-04 after an external review found it enforced but unregistered. It does NOT follow from R-POWER-LOCAL, whose text only demands that every machine body have one cell inside some local pole stencil; the cap is an independent budget. It is enforced in three places: the per-region generator model (`g1_pattern_generator._solve_target`, `sum(pole_vars) <= min(MAX_POLES_PER_REGION, body_total)`), the evaluator's postcheck (`g1_pattern_evaluator.evaluate_pattern`, poles above the cap are rejected as an R-POWER-LOCAL violation), and the packing-ceiling relaxation (`g1_pattern_generator`, `sum(pole_vars) <= MAX_POLES_PER_REGION`). The frozen rules contain no per-region pole budget -- `rules/canonical_rules.json` gives `power_pole` only a 2x2 body and `power_coverage_radius = 5` -- and the source comment on the constant calls it a 'soft budget used by the generator'. Consequence for the numbers: the 3,392 packing ceiling and every catalog price tag derived from it are conditional on this cap; it has not been priced.
